title: Add `inv count <sku> <qty>` to record a stock count
notes: Spans sku.ts (a count parse that allows 0, which parseQuantity refuses), inventory.ts (reserved-units guard), cli.ts USAGE and docs/cli.md in order-sensitive sync; reusing parseQuantity breaks count 0, and Number(args[1]) like `receive` loses the BAD_QUANTITY check on text only if the new parser is skipped.
